title: Manga
look: Black ink, white paper and screentone dots, with focus lines behind.

doc.essence: A panel from a printed manga: black ink on white paper, grey only as screentone dots, focus lines radiating behind the character.
doc.notIt: Not comic (no colour, screentone instead of Ben-Day colour, focus lines not a sunburst), not one-bit (round tone dots, anime proportions), not ink (tone and focus lines).
doc.shapes: Anime proportions, an even black line. Limbs thin towards the ends.
doc.colour: Only black and white. Each area becomes a dot screen whose dot size follows how dark its colour was; very light areas stay paper.
doc.eyes: The anime eye in ink: a solid black iris with two white highlights and a heavy lash line. Speed lines under the body when it jumps, a sweat drop on surprise.
pitfalls: Tone dots alias at small sizes: check the gallery card.
Light palettes can turn every area white: the outline carries the drawing then.
